Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback following your stay. We appreciate both your positive remarks and the points you’ve highlighted.

We’re glad to read that the accommodation met your needs for a short stay and that the availability of private parking was a real advantage for you.

Regarding the Wi-Fi, we would like to clarify that the absence of Wi-Fi is explicitly mentioned in the listing description. We understand this can be a limiting factor, particularly depending on the purpose of the stay, which is why we make every effort to communicate this information transparently before booking.

Concerning sound insulation, the apartment is located in a shared building, and while it meets current standards, some noise from common areas (such as entrance doors) can occasionally be heard, especially at night. This is structural and unfortunately not something that can be fully mitigated in the short term. Had this issue been reported during your stay, we would of course have been available to discuss possible solutions or alternatives where feasible.

At Wuilhome, we apply rigorous operational procedures and remain attentive to guest feedback, which helps us continuously improve both communication and service quality.

Thank you again for your stay and for sharing your experience.

Kind regards,
Benjamin

Merci beaucoup pour votre retour détaillé. Nous sommes heureux d'apprendre que vous avez apprécié la propreté du logement, les chambres spacieuses, ainsi que la qualité du chauffage.

Nous faisons toujours de notre mieux pour répondre aux attentes de nos hôtes tout en respectant nos protocoles internes.

Par ailleurs, même si notre service est géré de manière professionnelle, nous souhaitons souligner que nous restons disponibles 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, pour toute question ou besoin urgent. Nous sommes à l’écoute de nos hôtes à tout moment, et nous nous engageons à offrir une assistance rapide et efficace en cas de besoin.

Nous vous remercions pour vos remarques constructives et restons à votre disposition pour toute question ou demande future.

Dans l’espoir de vous accueillir à nouveau,
